hints.content:
###Step 1: Recognizing that we have an isosceles triangle

This is an isosceles triangle because it has two congruent sides $($the two sides with a length of $4)$. The angles across from the congruent sides are also congruent, so the angle without a label measures $56^\circ$:



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A triangle with angle x degrees and its opposite side has a length of four point five, an angle of fifty-six degrees and its opposite side has a length of four, and an angle of fifty-six degrees and its third side has a length of four.

hints.content:
###Step 2: Writing an equation

The three angles in a triangle add up to $180 ^\circ$.
We can write this as an equation:

$x^\circ + 56^\circ + 56^\circ = 180^\circ$

###Step 3: Solving for $x$

$\begin{align} x + 56 + 56 &= 180 \\\\
x + 112 &= 180 &\gray{\text{Simplify the left-hand side}}\\\\
x + 112 - \blueD{112} &= 180 - \blueD{112} &\gray{\text{Subtract 112 from each side}}\\\\
x &= 68 \end{align}$
